phases.name: Foundation: production-grade autonomous infrastructure operations platform
phases.description: Unified lifecycle objects, schema-versioned atomic memory, observability, Proxmox intelligence, decision engine, approval gates, remediation + rollback, security hardening, learning loop, full test suite, documentation.
completion_criteria: deployed and running as systemd services

phases.name: CloudCLI plugin integration
phases.description: AI Application Builder plugin (client + server bridge) installed into CloudCLI, bearer-token-authenticated write API on core/api.py.
completion_criteria: Plugin tab renders in live CloudCLI browser session
Overview/Approvals/Learning tabs show real data, not fixtures

phases.name: Headless Claude Agent SDK bridge
phases.description: core/coding_bridge.py drives CloudCLI's existing /api/agent endpoint non-interactively -- no second coding engine.
completion_criteria: Real file write + real git commit proven against a disposable repo, not mocked

phases.name: Application Builder Lifecycle
phases.description: core/build_manager.py state machine (REQUESTED..COMPLETED/FAILED/ROLLED_BACK) on core/lifecycle.py primitives, own approval queue isolated from the incident/remediation pipeline.

phases.name: Code generation pipeline
phases.description: core/repo_manager.py (idempotent git repo bootstrap, per-build branch) + core/project_templates.py (6 scaffolding prompts, not boilerplate files).
completion_criteria: Every build runs on its own build-<id> branch

phases.name: Sandbox execution
phases.description: core/sandbox.py -- Docker-based disposable/resource-limited/network-optional command execution. Deliberately not wired into CloudCLI's own coding-agent process (too large a change for one phase); deliberately excludes docker build (socket-mount risk).
completion_criteria: Real Docker integration tests: host filesystem isolation and project-dir writability both proven

phases.name: Security intelligence
phases.description: core/security_scanner.py -- Bandit, Semgrep, npm audit, Trivy, all run inside the Phase 12E sandbox. Wired into build_manager: GENERATING -> SECURITY_REVIEW -> DEPLOY_APPROVAL.
completion_criteria: Real findings (not zero) produced against a deliberately vulnerable fixture

phases.name: Deployment platform with real rollback
phases.description: core/deployment_manager.py -- staging/production blue-green swap via Docker, real rollback registered against core/remediation.py's existing (previously unused) ROLLBACK_STRATEGIES extension point.
completion_criteria: Real end-to-end deploy proven: file written, container running, HTTP-reachable

phases.name: Learning system expansion
phases.description: core/build_learning.py -- template success-rate tracking, same trusted/observe/avoid thresholds as the existing remediation learning_engine.
completion_criteria: Wired into every terminal build-state transition

phases.name: Local AI architecture prep
phases.description: core/ai_provider.py registry -- extension point only, no local model installed.

phases.name: Multi-AI provider router
phases.description: core/ai/ai_router.py -- real Gemini/Groq/OpenAI delegation, role-based routing with automatic fallback, honest per-provider quota/health tracking, security-audited credential handling. CloudCLI plugin dashboard tab added.
completion_criteria: Live, non-mocked delegation proven for at least 2 of the 3 non-Claude roles
security checklist verified with real commands

phases.name: Autonomous Roadmap Engine
phases.description: roadmap.json + core/roadmap_engine.py -- machine-readable phase/dependency/status tracking so the system itself (not just this session's own task list) can answer "what remains to be built?"

phases.name: Autonomous Engineering Manager
phases.description: Given the roadmap, autonomously plan/delegate/implement/test/review/deploy/learn until 'Complete the roadmap' is achieved. Human remains final authority via the existing approval gates (architecture approval, deploy approval) -- explicitly must not remove those.
completion_criteria: Not yet defined in detail -- this is the largest remaining architectural/policy decision in the roadmap, deliberately not started without explicit sign-off on autonomy scope

phases.name: Kai Identity Layer
phases.description: core/kai/ -- identity.py, mission.py, goals.py, policies.py. Restrictions enforced via source-grep test (no approve_architecture(/approve_deploy( calls anywhere in core/kai/) plus PROTECTED_FILES flagging for approval/audit/security file changes.

phases.name: Kai Command Interface
phases.description: Rule-based phrase matching (not an LLM intent classifier) mapping fixed commands to existing functions: 'Kai, analyze system health' -> core.health.analyze() + core.ai.provider_health, 'Kai, find improvements' / 'Kai, create an improvement proposal' -> 13C's planner, 'Kai, continue roadmap' -> core.roadmap_manager.advance_roadmap(), 'Kai, review recent failures' -> core.build_learning.get_build_history() filtered to FAILED/ROLLED_BACK, 'Kai, prepare the next engineering phase' -> core.roadmap_engine.get_next_phase(). New: core/kai/commands.py with a small COMMAND_PATTERNS table + dispatch(text) -> result. Reuse: roadmap_engine, build_manager, ai_router, build_learning -- no new AI-calling code.
phases.note: Superseded by K1 -- core/kai/commands.py already built, tested, and deployed; this build would only duplicate it.

phases.name: Kai Strategic Planner
phases.description: core/kai/planner.py. Reviews roadmap (roadmap_engine), system health (core.health.analyze), recent build failures (build_learning.get_build_history), and AI usage/quota (ai_router.get_usage_history, provider_health) to produce Improvement Proposal objects -- a new lifecycle.py-based object type (proposed -> under_review -> approved/rejected -> implemented), stored in memory/improvement_proposals.json. Research/analysis calls route through the existing ai_router.delegate(), not new AI-calling code. Proposals do not auto-create roadmap items or builds -- that requires a separate human or 13B-command action promoting a proposal into a roadmap phase (via add_phase, defaulting to 'proposed' status per 13A's design).

phases.name: Kai AI Workforce Manager
phases.description: core/ai/agent_roles.py -- thin semantic wrapper over the existing ai_router.delegate(), not a parallel routing system. Named roles: Architecture Agent (Claude), Research Agent (Gemini), Fast Analysis Agent (Groq), General Reasoning Agent (OpenAI when available). Note: only Claude has coding_agent capability today (confirmed in ai_provider.py) -- 'assigning AI provider' for actual code generation has no real choice to make yet, it's always Claude; this phase's real work is formalizing role names for the surrounding research/analysis/review tasks that already route through ai_router. Requires one new ai_router task_type ('review' -> [openai, gemini, claude], since nothing maps to OpenAI today).

phases.name: Kai Autonomous Development Loop
phases.description: Upgrade core/roadmap_manager.py's advance_roadmap(): 'highest-value' phase selection (score by risk/expected-benefit from the originating Improvement Proposal, not just priority number), and wire real test execution into the GENERATING step for self-modifying builds specifically (the test command is known and fixed for this repo: .venv/bin/pytest tests/, unlike the generic 'what's the test command for an arbitrary generated app' problem Phase 12E left open). Reuse build_manager/coding_bridge/security_scanner/deployment_manager as-is. Approval gates (ARCHITECTURE_APPROVED, DEPLOY_APPROVAL) remain untouched and mandatory -- this phase must not add any path that bypasses them.

phases.name: Kai Memory System
phases.description: Extend core/build_learning.py: capture rollback root-cause (rollback_deployment currently records ROLLED_BACK as a failure in success-rate math but not why) and rejected-proposal reasons from 13C's Improvement Proposal store. Track preferred architectures, common failures, successful solutions, avoided approaches -- reuses the existing trusted/observe/avoid threshold pattern, no new classification scheme.

phases.name: Kai Dashboard
phases.description: New 'Kai Control Center' tab in the CloudCLI plugin (/project/src/ai-orchestrator-plugin), same tab pattern already used for Overview/Approvals/Learning/AI Providers. Displays Kai status/identity, current goals, active tasks, proposals (13C), delegated AI tasks (ai_router usage history), roadmap progress, pending approvals, completed improvements, lessons learned (13F). Reuses existing read endpoints plus whatever new ones 13B/13C/13F add -- no duplicate UI patterns.

phases.name: Kai Controlled Autonomy Levels
phases.description: Replace the binary memory/autonomous_mode.json (Phase 12L) with 6 numbered levels (0=manual, 1=observe+report [default], 2=create proposals, 3=create branches/builds, 4=execute through deploy-approval [today's 'enabled: true' behavior], 5=continuously manages roadmap incl. self-generated phases). Deprecate the binary flag outright rather than maintain both. The Overview tab's toggle becomes a 6-position control instead of on/off. Policy tests proving each level only unlocks what it claims to, and that no level ever bypasses ARCHITECTURE_APPROVED/DEPLOY_APPROVAL.

phases.name: Kai Future Roadmap Generator
phases.description: Kai can create NEW roadmap phases (e.g. Phase 14+) from its own observations, using roadmap_engine.add_phase() (Phase 13A) -- always defaulting to status='proposed', never 'pending', so a human must explicitly promote it before get_next_phase()/advance_roadmap() will ever act on it. This is the mechanism that makes 'AI can propose roadmap items, AI cannot approve its own changes' actually true rather than just documented.

phases.name: Kai Command Interface (entry point)
phases.description: Validate and commit the existing rule-based dispatcher (core/kai/commands.py, written by the failed-but-actually-successful 13B build) and give it a real external entry point. No NLP -- fixed phrase table, per the original 13B spec.

phases.name: Kai Command HTTP Endpoint
phases.description: POST /kai/command on core/api.py, bearer-token gated like every other write endpoint, calling core.kai.commands.dispatch(text). Makes 'talk to Kai' reachable from outside a Python REPL for the first time.

phases.name: Isolate self-modifying build workspace
phases.description: Self-modifying builds (project_path=SELF_PROJECT_PATH) currently operate directly in /project/ai-orchestrator, the same live directory this interactive session uses. Give them an isolated clone instead -- root cause of tonight's observed generation failures and repeated branch collisions.

phases.name: Quota-aware AI router ordering
phases.description: ai_router.delegate() currently tries candidates in a fixed static order per role. Consult provider_health.get_quota_snapshot() (already-collected data) to skip/deprioritize providers known to be quota-exhausted or erroring.
